details: I know with VRC we are expected to have Groups incoming and I think if anything if that is an incoming update for the game there needs to be something pushed alongside it: Web and Client messaging. Not only that but event hosting on a calandar that is hosted by VRC themselves where partners of VRC or developers or world creators people VRC moderate for different events etc can do.  Also with Groups there needs to be options for their own events and calandar like a private one only the group can see or possibly have +1 guests where members can bring a friend and invite them. Invites would be user based as well as events be tied to the user within the group. Alert pops once event has started and an instance created by main host will be broadcasted to the group so they can join. Messaging can deliver all of these as well as make planning events with people easier if there was group messaging within the group. Also for non group scenarios I still think messaging should be pushed both on web and in client same way as Xbox Live PSN or even Nintendo Online handle their messaging. Its a simple push to add to the Group feature which I know its a lot of work for infrastructure and back end but frankly the feature would help retain newer members who are looking to have fun with others but lets say someone is not online at that very moment they can message them and if the person is on web client they can check messages and reply to them letting them know hey I will be on in a few minutes. It would just help out a lot as not everyone is in Discord not everyone can communicate very well, it would be much much easier if we had this messaging system implemented so that we can ensure communication within a VR Social game is paramount.
title: Messaging and Social Feature Revamp
